title: Bladder Botox for overactive bladder
what: Using a thin camera, the doctor gives several injections into the bladder wall. The bladder calms down, and urges come less often.
why: For an overactive bladder, when pills and exercises have not helped.
duration: the procedure usually takes 20 to 40 minutes; it starts working in 1 to 2 weeks and usually lasts several months
tell_doctor: If you have a urine infection or fever now

prepare.title: Urine test
prepare.text: Before the procedure, your urine is usually checked for infection.

prepare.title: Numbing
prepare.text: Usually local numbing, sometimes anesthesia. If you have anesthesia, the clinic will tell you when to stop eating and drinking.

prepare.title: Antibiotic
prepare.text: Sometimes the doctor prescribes an antibiotic to prevent infection. Take it as directed.

bring: Your bladder diary, if you kept one
steps: You lie on the exam chair
A numbing gel is put into the urethra
A thin camera is passed into the bladder
Through it, several injections are given into the bladder wall
The camera is removed, and you rest
Before you leave, the staff check that you can pee
feel: Pressure and urges during the procedure
You feel the injections. It is usually bearable
Burning when you pee may happen for the first few days
after: Drink as usual. For the first few days, your urine may be pinkish
Sometimes the bladder empties less well. Your doctor will tell you how to check
A follow-up visit in a few weeks
When the effect wears off, the procedure can be repeated. The doctor decides
red_flags: You cannot pee, or your bladder feels full: call the clinic
A fever over 38°C or severe pain
Muscle weakness, or trouble swallowing or breathing: call emergency services

faq.q: Is this the same Botox used for wrinkles?
faq.a: The active ingredient is the same, but the dose and place are different. This is a medical treatment.
Usually several months. When the urges come back, the doctor will decide whether to repeat it.

reminders.text: Bladder procedure tomorrow. Bring your urine test and list of medicines.
